supportAccess.title: Support access
supportAccess.intro: Whoever operates this instance cannot look inside your data unless you let them. Nothing here is granted by default, and you can take it back at any time.
supportAccess.loadFailed: Could not read the current setting.

NONE.name: No access
NONE.desc: The operator sees that your tenant exists and nothing else. Requests into your data are refused.

READ.name: Read only
READ.desc: The operator can look at your alerts, logs and configuration to help you. They cannot change anything — every write is refused, whatever their own role says.

FULL.name: Full access
FULL.desc: The operator can act inside your tenant as an administrator: change configuration, users and response flows.

supportAccess.fullWarning: Full access lets the operator change things on your behalf. Grant it while you need hands-on help, and drop back afterwards.
supportAccess.revokeNote: Everything the operator does here is recorded in your audit log.
